=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.

8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.

2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.

2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.

[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).

[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.

10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Greek Hold 'em Mini II ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.

In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). 8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.

10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. You are reviewing a game that has finished. You were not a player. You are shown everything: the messages the table was told, every move, and each player's private thinking at every move, which no other player ever saw. Each move carries the notes its game asked for, under their own names. The usual ones are:

  plan     what they meant to do over the coming turns
  reason   why they made that move
  predict  what they expected their opponents to do
  adjust   how they changed their own strategy because of that

Write two things.

First, a summary of the whole game as it unfolded: the turning points, the moves that decided it, and how it ended. Concrete: name seats, rounds and numbers.

Second, a review of each player. Judge their play, not their luck. For each one, compare their predictions with what their opponents were actually thinking and actually did: were they right, and did they see it in time? Did their adjustments follow from their predictions, and did their moves follow from their reasons? Point out their best and worst moves. Then score their play from 1 to 10, where 1 is aimless or self-defeating and 10 is sharp, well read and well executed. A player can lose and still score well, or win and score badly.

A player who gave no reasons, predictions or adjustments is judged on their moves alone; say that their thinking was not recorded.

Refer to each player by seat, and as "they".

THE GAME
Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, each start with a chip total of 0. Totals may go negative and may include fractions from split pots. The deck has 18 cards: ranks 1 to 6, 3 copies of each, with no suits. The game lasts exactly 36 hands. In hand h, the first actor is seat ((h - 1) mod 3) + 1, the second actor is the next seat after the first actor (wrapping from 3 to 1), and the third actor is the remaining seat.

Each hand:
1. Deal. All 18 cards are shuffled. Each player gets 2 hole cards face down and 4 board cards are dealt face down to the table. Each player sees only their own hole cards.
2. Ante. Each player pays 1 chip into the pot. The pot starts at 3.
3. Board. Board cards 1, 2 and 3 are turned face up. Board card 4 stays face down.
4. The first actor chooses CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. A bet is paid into the pot at once, and the choice is announced to all.
5. The second actor chooses, announced to all. If nobody has bet yet: CHECK, BET 2 or BET 4. If a bet has been made: CALL (pay the same amount as the bet into the pot and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing everything already paid).
6. The third actor chooses, with the same options as the second actor, announced to all.
7. Response. Only if a bet was made after at least one player checked: each player who checked before the bet chooses, at the same moment, CALL (pay the bet amount and stay in) or FOLD (leave the hand, losing what was paid). The choices are then revealed. Only one bet is ever made in a hand: there are no raises, and the bettor never acts again.
8. Final board. Board card 4 is turned face up.
9. Hand scores. With hole ranks a and b: score = a + b, plus 6 if a equals b, plus 4 for each board card whose rank equals a or b, counting at most 3 matches.
10. Showdown. If exactly one player has not folded, that player takes the whole pot and no hole cards are revealed. If two or three are still in, their hole cards and scores are revealed and the pot goes to the highest score among them; players tied for the highest score split the pot equally. If everyone checked, all three go to showdown.
11. Folded players' hole cards are never revealed.
12. Each player's total changes by the chips they won minus the chips they paid this hand. All three totals are announced. The totals always sum to 0.
13. All cards return to the deck for the next shuffle.

After hand 36 the game ends. The highest chip total wins; players tied at the top share the win.
